scenarios.claim: A consumer importing package oauth2 can construct a client, build and execute every documented flow request, introspect and revoke tokens, inject a custom HTTP client, and receive the documented response and error types.
scenarios.surface: public Go package API (client assembly, flow requests, introspection, revocation, request/response handling, HTTP client abstraction, error contract)
scenarios.normalization: normalized observable projection: request method/url/headers/form-body or response fields or RequestTokenError kind, compared after case/parameter normalization

scenarios.claim: NewBasicClient(NewClientId("id")) defaults AuthType to BasicAuth; each of SetAuthURL, SetTokenURL, SetRedirectURL, SetDeviceAuthorizationURL, SetIntrospectionURL, SetRevocationURL and SetClientSecret stores its value with the matching accessor returning it, and the conditional Set*URLOption setters accept an optional endpoint while flow accessors are fallible.
scenarios.surface: client construction and endpoint setters/accessors
scenarios.normalization: normalized observable projection: request method/url/headers/form-body or response fields or RequestTokenError kind, compared after case/parameter normalization

scenarios.claim: Executing any flow request through a fake client yields an HTTPRequest with Method "POST", Header["Content-Type"] == "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", Header["Accept"] == "application/json", and a form-encoded body.

scenarios.claim: With BasicAuth and a client secret the request carries Authorization: Basic base64(urlencode(client_id):urlencode(client_secret)) and omits client_id/client_secret from the body; with RequestBody auth (or no secret) client_id, and client_secret when set, appear in the form body instead.

scenarios.claim: AuthorizationRequest.URL() always contains response_type, client_id and state; contains code_challenge and code_challenge_method only when a PKCE challenge is set; contains redirect_uri only when a redirect URL is set; contains scope (space-joined) only when scopes exist; and appends extra parameters, with default response_type=code, UseImplicitFlow selecting token, and SetResponseType supporting a custom value.
